reason: This gap aims to compare the prevalence of prenatal complications between infants who experienced Sudden Unexpected Infant Death (SUID) and those with congenital anomalies, birth injuries, respiratory distress syndrome, or prematurity using a case-case study design within the NFR-CRS dataset. The absence of a denominator source means that this comparison can only establish proportions among cases but cannot provide incidence rates or causal inferences.
